verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents loading from databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL guides) and from object storage (S3, GCS, Azure), plus a dbt-duckdb transformation integration with setup steps and scheduled Python 'Flights' jobs for custom ingest. The evidence shows no SaaS-app connectors and no ETL/ELT partner tools, so those sources would need custom Python jobs. Missing for 10: first-party or partner SaaS app connectors, documented ETL/ELT partner integrations (e.g. managed ingestion tools), breadth of database connectors beyond Postgres/MySQL, independent corroboration.
